fontLicensePolicy: Existing renamed Source Sans 3 Regular WOFF2 reused unchanged at weight400 in both variants. Original source and OFL notice retained.
mode: Previously generated photographic artwork and print/device presentations reused unchanged. Native text and chart geometry composed separately. No new image generation.

layout_record.method: Fill-only consolidation. Source images, typography and geometry fixed. Replacement hues approximately match relative luminance to keep the intervention distinct from repairing weak text/background contrast.

comparisonPolicy: Only assigned fills change: four poster text colors become existing green; three monthly bar fills become existing blue; four ordinary UI text fills and a button fill are consolidated while status surfaces and labels remain identical. Replacements approximately match relative luminance. Every word, size, weight, font, position, bar value/geometry, photo byte/crop, paper/device and lighting stays fixed.

verification.textBounds: within the declared paper or phone surface
verification.pixelCheck: Only intended declared palette intervention regions differ.
verification.scope: Exact DOM normalization permits only declared fill attributes. All other nodes, typography, text, source bytes, photo crops and geometry remain identical. Wide/stacked surfaces, font loading, fitting text, horizontal overflow and image/inline SVG equality checked. Pixel differences are restricted to declared regions.

limitations: Editorial fictional examples, not measured comprehension or engagement. Color-count scopes exclude photographic/paper colors and preserve required functional states. Relative-luminance matching is approximate after 8-bit RGB quantization and does not establish equal perceived lightness. Static booking mockup, not an implemented service, physical print proof or full accessibility evaluation.
